_comment: Feature 0074 #15: outputs of the agent's shared.audit_runner._redact_secret_line; the Go port must reproduce them byte for byte. `prose_cases` (0074 T3, re-audit #15/R4/R10) pin the PROSE-aware text redactor: Go textutil.RedactSecretText and the agent's merged_llm description redactor must both map each `in` to its `out` byte for byte. It runs the line redactor above on each line, then masks (a) a secret-named key followed by ':' or '=' (password, passwd, pwd, secret, token, api key, access key, private key, optionally prefixed by a compound name such as db_) and (b) key-like tokens (sk-/pk-/rk- live|test|proj keys, long sk- keys, AKIA/ASIA access key ids, GitHub gh?_ tokens, Slack xox?- tokens), each only at a boundary that is not [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Every `cases` row also maps to its `out` under the prose redactor. Whitespace and word characters are spelled out, never \s / \w (Go's are ASCII, Python's Unicode): whitespace is exactly Go's unicode.IsSpace set (\v, U+0085, U+00A0 and the Unicode spaces included; U+001C-U+001F and U+FEFF are not whitespace), and an identifier character is [A-Za-z0-9_] or any non-ASCII character that is not whitespace. Case folding treats U+0130 and U+0131 as i, as Python does. The non-ASCII rows pin that.
